title: Obtaining Policy Group Set Details Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information on obtaining ZPA policy group set details using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Getting Details of All Policy Group Sets

blocks.text: To get details of all policy group sets:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/policyGroupSetµtenantId={microtenantId}&createIfNotExist={true/false}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.

microtenantId: The unique identifier of the Microtenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant. To learn more, see Configuring Microtenants Using API.
createIfNotExist: Indicates if the global policy set does not exist and must be created (i.e., createIfNotExist=true).
For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73255551684837376/policyGroupSetµtenantId=0&createIfNotExist=true.
View an example response.

[ { "id": "73255551684837495", "name": "Global_Policy_GROUP_SET-0", "policyGroupSummaryList": [ { "id": "73255551684837496", "name": "Global Policy Group", "ruleCount": "2", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "GLOBAL", "groupOrder": "1", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837609", "name": "test-group-6", "ruleCount": "0", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "2", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837655", "name": "test-group", "ruleCount": "1", "groupCriteriaCount": "1", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "3", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837659", "name": "ZCC policy group", "ruleCount": "1", "groupCriteriaCount": "1", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "4", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837663", "name": "Contractors", "ruleCount": "0", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "5", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837665", "name": "Contracter Ayhan", "ruleCount": "0", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "6", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837667", "name": "Ayhan Group", "ruleCount": "0", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "7", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837608", "name": "test-group-5", "ruleCount": "0", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "CUSTOM", "groupOrder": "8", "permissionLevel": "FULL" }, { "id": "73255551684837497", "name": "Default Policy Group", "ruleCount": "3", "groupCriteriaCount": "0", "type": "DEFAULT", "groupOrder": "9", "permissionLevel": "FULL" } ], "policyType": "1", "groupCountExcludingGlobal": "8", "groupTypeStats": { "customCount": "7", "globalCount": "1", "defaultCount": "1" } } ]

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Getting Details of a Specific Policy Group Set

blocks.text: To get details of a specific policy group set by ID:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/policyGroupSet/{groupSetId}µtenantId={microtenantId}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.

microtenantId: The unique identifier of the Microtenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant. To learn more, see Configuring Microtenants Using API.
For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73255551684837376/policyGroupSet/73255551684837495µtenantId=0.
View an example response.

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Getting Policy Group Set Details by Policy Type

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/policyGroupSet/policyType/{policyType}µtenantId={microtenantId}&createIfNotExist={true/false}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
policyType: The policy type. The supported value must be GLOBAL_POLICY or ACCESS_POLICY.

microtenantId: The unique identifier of the Microtenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant. To learn more, see Configuring Microtenants Using API.
createIfNotExist: Indicates if the global policy set does not exist and must be created (i.e., createIfNotExist=true).
For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73255551684837376/policyGroupSet/policyType/ACCESS_POLICYµtenantId=0&createIfNotExist=true.

Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
policyType: The policy type. The supported value must be GLOBAL_POLICY or ACCESS_POLICY.

microtenantId: The unique identifier of the Microtenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant. To learn more, see Configuring Microtenants Using API.

blocks.heading: Getting the Policy Group Set Summary Stats by Policy Type

blocks.text: To get the aggregate counts across all groups and rules within the policy group set for the specified policy type:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/policyGroupSet/policyType/{policyType}/summaryStatsµtenantId={microtenantId}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
policyType: The policy type. The supported value must be GLOBAL_POLICY or ACCESS_POLICY.

microtenantId: The unique identifier of the Microtenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant. To learn more, see Configuring Microtenants Using API.
For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73255551684837376/policyGroupSet/policyType/GLOBAL_POLICY/summaryStatsµtenantId=0.
View an example response.
{ "totalRules": "7", "totalPolicyGroups": "9", "disabledRules": "1", "enabledRules": "6" }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
